observations.body: Authorities, former conduct, mercy, renewal, and good works. Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work, This saying is faithful, and about these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
